data.title: Indonesia's Prabowo approval rating drops to 51.1%, survey finds
data.description: JAKARTA - The approval ⁠rating ⁠of Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto ​fell to 51.1% in July 2026, a poll showed, with respondents pointing to the ​state of the country's economy more ‌than a year and a half into his term of office.

data.description: HONG KONG - China ⁠evacuated ⁠stranded tourists from the Unesco ​World Heritage site of Jiuzhaigou on Monday after mudslides triggered by heavy rain, ​state broadcaster CCTV reported, as authorities issued ‌the highest flash-flood alert for parts of the country in the wake of Typhoon Noul.

data.title: Whales at risk, hungry pelicans: Marine heat wave hits California
data.description: LONG BEACH (UNITED STATES) - On a boat off the coast of California, Sara Lesser gazes wistfully at dozens of dolphins playing in the vessel's wake. This summer, extreme heat is making such a scene increasingly rare.

data.title: 2,000 passengers stranded overnight at Hong Kong airport due to Typhoon Noul
data.description: About 2,000 passengers were stranded overnight at Hong Kong International Airport as Typhoon Noul battered the city, with some dismayed by their disrupted journeys while others complained about hotel room rates that had risen from HK$2,000 (8,600 baht) to HK$3,000 per night.

data.title: With minutes to flee, Spain fire evacuees grab what they can
data.description: VILLAMANTA, Spain - Ordered to flee their homes as wildfires raged nearby, Spanish villagers often only had minutes to seize what they could: most pets were banned and some had no chance to grab their medicine.

data.title: UK's Burnham to welcome Zelensky in first foreign leader visit
data.description: LONDON - British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will on Monday host Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky as his first foreign leader since taking office a week ago, to underline London's "unwavering support" for Kyiv.

data.title: Iran halts strikes as Trump gives space to talks
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran and the United States held their fire Sunday, handing Gulf shipping and the oil industry a respite from missile strikes as Donald Trump's UN envoy said the president was "giving talks some space".

data.title: Ex-president Hernandez returns to Honduras after Trump pardon
data.description: TEGUCIGALPA - Honduran ex-president Juan Orlando Hernandez returned to his country on Sunday, almost eight months after US President Donald Trump controversially pardoned his 45-year prison sentence for drug trafficking.

data.description: BORDEAUX, France - Fire crews in France and Spain battling unchecked wildfires that have forced more than 300,000 people to flee were overwhelmed by the task on Sunday as the unpredictable blazes continued to spread.

data.title: D-Day Normandy beaches now Unesco heritage site
data.description: PARIS - ⁠The ⁠Normandy D-Day beaches ​where Allied forces landed on June ​6, 1944, ‌to fight Adolf Hitler's Nazi troops and go on to liberate France have become a Unesco protected world heritage site, ​the ⁠United Nations body said on Sunday.

data.description: HONG KONG - Typhoon Noul will dump heavy to ​torrential rain across much ‌of southern China for two days after sweeping the province of Guangdong and neighbouring Hong Kong with gale-force winds, following landfall on Sunday, forecasters said.

data.description: SAO PAULO - Battered by a string of political crises, Flavio Bolsonaro on Saturday prepared to formally launch his candidacy for Brazil's October presidential election, seeking to follow in the footsteps of his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

data.description: BORDEAUX, France - Amid rows of camp beds and stacks of food supplies at a makeshift shelter in Bordeaux, thousands of tourists and locals try to regain their composure after fleeing wildfires sweeping through southwest France.

data.description: Strong ⁠winds and torrential rain ​lashed southern China on Saturday, brought by ​a strengthening typhoon Noul, ‌weather authorities said, urging people to avoid unnecessary travel as transport links could be disrupted.
